tagline: Nvidia takes Huang back, stock +31% · Strikes kill 15+ near Kyiv · Banten fire toll hits 24
numbers: Nvidia shares after Huang is reinstated as CEO
S&P 500, Wall Street's best day since April 2025
killed by Russian strikes in Kyiv region
dead in the Banten candy-factory fire

leads.headline: Nvidia reinstates Huang; stock jumps 31%
leads.dek: Board unanimously brings Huang back as CEO. S&P 500 +4.7% to 7,237, Wall Street's best day since April 2025.
leads.source: NBC News · CNBC · AP · Washington Post

leads.headline: Russian overnight strikes kill at least 15
leads.dek: Dymer: 11 dead in a five-storey block after a 22-hour rescue. Vyshneve supermarket: 3 dead, 15 hurt.
leads.source: Euronews · AFP · toll per Ukrainian officials

leads.headline: Candy-factory fire toll rises to at least 24
leads.dek: Police raise the toll on Monday; about 300 workers were inside when it began on Saturday. DNA needed to identify victims.

stories.headline: EU unveils 22nd Russia sanctions package
stories.dek: 60 more Russian banks off SWIFT, 70+ shadow-fleet ships. Aim: approval in December.

stories.headline: NATO meets over Russian missiles in Poland
stories.dek: Extraordinary session. Rutte: NATO will defend every inch.

stories.headline: India and Nepal sign 8 deals
stories.dek: Modi hosts Nepal PM Shah: Rs 15,000 crore (~$1.6bn) in grants and credit.

stories.headline: KOSPI slides 3.3% on AI-bubble fears
stories.dek: Lowest close since 13 Jan at 4,708.54; trading curb hit after a 5.8% drop.

stories.headline: Iran vows 'all tools' against US blockade
stories.dek: Spokesman Baghaei: Hormuz could reopen if the US ends the blockade and lifts sanctions.
stories.source: Khaleej Times · Times of Israel · Gulf News

stories.headline: Thai MP's royal-defamation verdict upheld
stories.dek: Rukchanok Srinork's term cut from 6 to 3 years; she will appeal.

stories.headline: Israeli strikes kill 4+, incl. UNRWA worker
stories.dek: UN agency worker Adel Al-Helo was killed near a water well.

stories.headline: Colombia car bomb injures 23
stories.dek: Meta governor's office: no deaths, 80+ kg of explosives; dissidents blamed, unconfirmed.

stories.headline: Court sets ruling on Senegal's AFCON title
stories.dek: CAS confirms its decision on CAF stripping Senegal of the 2025 title is due Tuesday.

stories.headline: India v New Zealand first Test drawn
stories.dek: New Zealand bat out day five at 239/5 after India's 720/9 declared.
